name: @pipeworx/mcp-caniuse

tools.name: feature
tools.description: Full caniuse record for a feature id (e.g. "css-grid", "fetch", "webp").

tools.name: search
tools.description: caniuse browser-compatibility database (the dataset behind caniuse.com) — find web platform feature ids by matching a keyword against feature id, title, keywords and description. Returns each match's caniuse feature id, human-readable title and standards status; feed the id to feature or support. Answers what the caniuse id is for CSS grid, container queries, or WebP.

tools.name: list_browsers
tools.description: Return all browser IDs tracked by caniuse (e.g. chrome, safari, firefox, edge, ios_saf) with their recent version strings; use IDs with the `support` tool.

tools.name: support
tools.description: Convenience: is this feature supported in this browser version? Returns the raw caniuse support string + a parsed verdict.

browser.description: Browser id (chrome, safari, firefox, edge, ios_saf, ...)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-caniuse forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the caniuse pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
